caption: The drawing depicts a single, vertically-oriented vessel that is olive green in color. The vessel has a narrow, short neck leading to a slightly wider mouth, and the body of the vessel expands outward before tapering gently at the bottom. The surface of the vessel is covered in textured and patterned designs, including diagonal lines, cross-hatching, and segmented geometric motifs. The middle section of the vessel is divided into rectangular panels with different patterns, while the upper and lower sections feature ribbed and linear textures. The vessel casts a soft shadow on a pale background, and the artist's signature "VAN SILVAY" is visible near the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Decanter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
